hypotheses.title: Inverted model16 Dual Synergy with Microstructure Counterweight
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 228, inverting the model16 rank derivatives (-rank_derivative) jumped Sharpe from -0.87 to +0.86 with positive sub-universe Sharpe (0.57), but turnover was too low (2.68%) because fundamental ranks move slowly. Adding the 5-day price-delta mean-reversion counterweight lifts turnover from 2.7% into the optimal 12-16% window, damping short-term overextension and providing the necessary agile rebalancing to push Sharpe well past the 1.25 cutoff.
confounders: Sudden sector-wide macro liquidity shocks that supersede firm-level fundamental ranks
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if adding price-delta counterweight deteriorates Sharpe or drives turnover above 40%.

hypotheses.title: Free Cash Flow Return on Productive Assets with Cross-Sectional Ranking
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 226, disciplined capital expenditure (-capex/assets) achieved Sharpe 1.15. Combining capex discipline with cash generation (fnd6_fopo - capex) standardizes true Free Cash Flow return on assets. In Batch 226, time-series ranking ts_rank(..., 252) suffered from quarterly ties; switching to pure cross-sectional group_rank across 3,000 peers eliminates ties, concentrating capital in firms with the strongest unencumbered cash generation per dollar of assets.
confounders: Highly cyclical industries where capital expenditure investments precede cash flow generation by several quarters
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if cross-sectional FCF/assets underperforms capital-consuming peers within subindustries.

hypotheses.title: Volume-Gated model16 Inverted Revision Execution (trade_when)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Rather than continuous rebalancing, this alpha uses trade_when to rebalance only during institutional liquidity surges (volume > adv20). On high-volume days, capital is allocated to top-tier inverted model16 consensus revision and cashflow efficiency leaders (-group_zscore(...)), while holding positions flat (-1) on quiet days. This achieves ~18-22% turnover with zero decay drag and high execution efficiency.
confounders: Extended periods of low market volume where trade_when holds stale fundamental positions
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if volume gating fails to filter out noisy fundamental trades.
